additional_info.subject: ID0477214 - ID0477214-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / RN 170002846] Charging Station Issue CRM:03289000495
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your request, and after checking the charger, we see that all the charging session stopped charging, because the network was unreachable between the charger and the car.
We see that the error message of de secc pilot is E, was displayed every time after the connection was lost between the charger and the car. This is a safety error, where the charger stopped charging because of safety.
As you can see in the logs, the SSL handshake between the car and the charger was lost during this time.
The charger resolved this error every time automatically.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0477214 - ID0477214-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / RN 170002846] Charging Station Issue CRM:03289000495
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern,
Thank you for your patience regarding the issue with the charger.
We have looked into the charger again, and have checked the logs on error flags.
We found that outlet 1 and 2 are showing errors within the charger, what causes the charging sessions to stop during charging. Only the error of outlet 2 is live in the error flags.
DC1 is related to QA21-22 problems, and DC2 is related to QA13-14.
See the attached screenshot below.
We will monitor the charger for 24hours to see if the error of DC1 will also show in the error flags, and in the logs.
This way we know, if there needs to be a check on both outlets or only one.
After these 24hours we will forward this ticket to the region to do an on-site check.
We will keep you updated about this matter.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
